**Log**

Upload `logs/latest.log` from your game directory as a Gist or a file attachment - not pasted
inline. If the game crashed, attach the crash report from `crash-reports/` too. Without a log most
bugs cannot be diagnosed.

**Which feature**

`toolkit` / `colossus` / `powers` / `rules` / `evolve` / `events` / `arsenal` / `vault`, if you
know. Does the problem go away with `/creator feature <id> false`?
